title: Worse with every update
text: My company had me start using this app to scan paperwork and convert to PDF when I first started here. For that task it works “ok”. I got tired of the incessant ads and paid for premium ONLY to avoid the ads, not premium features. Original it was very simple to scan and save the PDF. With every update the unneeded and extensive menus require more and more. Clicks to save the file to my phone. You literally can’t even straight forward save a PDF anymore. I literally have to save a “long image” to be able to get to a menu to save a PDF. I won’t be surprised if they eventually add a “Platinum tier” at double the cost  that removes all the bloat so you can click 3 times and just save a PDF. It’s literally like Windows and iOS. Literally adding more and more features to complicate things unnecessarily.

title: STOP WITH THE SUBSCRIPTIONS
text:
Used for years to export pdfs of my handwritten homework to submit for my classes. You can imagine my disappointment when I go to export the pdf for my latest assignment, like I always have, and am prompted to pay for a subscription as it is now a subscription only feature. Are we joking? 

If any developers are interested in knowing how to keep people using your app, here’s a novelty idea that might shock you, keep the basic features free. Or at least keep the subscription price low enough to be insignificant. $10/ month just to export some freaking pdfs is WILD. Especially because there are hundreds of websites that do it for free (which I will be using over this garbage cash grab of an app).

title: I’ve reported this app billing tactics the FTC
text: Downloaded this app on October 19 2026. Signed up for a free trial and there was a tick box that said Mark here if you would like to be notified before your free trial end so you’re not billed. The app doesn’t send a push notification to your phone. It sends a quiet notification to the app messaging portal, which does not notify you that it was trying to get your attention. I brought this up to CamScanner and was redirected back to Apple to issue a refund. Apple denied the refund and when I brought that up to CamScanner, they said well that’s the final word and I said OK cool. Since then I have filed a fraud submission with the FTC against CamScanner because that is incredibly disingenuous of a service to blatantly say we’re gonna notify you so that you’re not billed and then they choose to do so in a way that is controlled to their environment only and if you’re not using the app, you’re not gonna be reminded because you’ll never see the notification. It is 2026. We are not playing with people’s money.
